material: Steel enclosure, vacuum circuit breakers, C5 coating
remarks: Busbar 2000 A (incomer 10BBT 31.5 MVA = 1,732 A; with tie closed one section carries the whole 13.9 MVA = 765 A). MV switchgear 12 kV class, 31.5 kA / 1 s (peak 80 kA): bus-tie closed short-circuit = 10BBT 14.4 kA + 20BBT 8.8 kA + MV motor contribution about 2 kA = 25 kA, 25 % margin; 40 kA not required. Panels: incomer, tie, BFP A, CEP A, CW pump A, SWRO HP pump A, LV transformers 00BFT10/30, spare.
service: 10.5 kV MV switchboard section A (fed from GT UAT 10BBT)
